resumeText:
Omkar Joshi | Pune | omkar.joshi@example.com | github.com/omkar-robotics

EDUCATION
B.Tech Mechatronics Engineering, MIT World Peace University, Pune, 2026 | CGPA 8.2/10

INTERNSHIPS
Robotics Intern, Sinhagad Automation Pvt Ltd, Pune | Jan 2026 - Apr 2026 (12 weeks)
- Wrote ROS 2 nodes in Python to read wheel encoder data and publish odometry for a warehouse robot.
- Tested the robot's motion in Gazebo simulation before running it in the lab.
- Set up Ubuntu 22.04 and ROS 2 Humble on the robot's onboard computer and fixed driver issues.

Design Intern, Chakan Precision Tools, Pune | June 2025 - July 2025 (6 weeks)
- Made SolidWorks models of fixture parts for the shop floor.

PROJECTS
- Autonomous Campus Rover (final-year project): Built a map of the college corridor with slam_toolbox on a TurtleBot3 and localized the robot on it with AMCL.
- Robotic arm: 4-DOF arm driven by servos and an Arduino, picking objects by colour using a webcam.
- Line follower robot for the college robotics competition.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- Coursework: Robotics and Control, Kinematics of Machines, Microcontrollers, Machine Vision
- ROS 2 for Beginners (Udemy), 2025

SKILLS
ROS 2, Python, C++, Ubuntu Linux, Gazebo, Nav2 (basics), SolidWorks, Arduino, Git

ACTIVITIES
- Team lead, college Robocon team, 2025.
